about: PhysicsMind evaluation set, written 15 Nov 2026 before PhysicsMind was run on any of it. Givens were converted to SI by hand; expected heights come from h = u_y^2 / 2g with u_y = u sin(angle from the horizontal), the given vertical speed, or g times the time to the top. Angles are degrees from the horizontal (90 = straight up). g is 9.8 m/s^2 unless given.
